# Run ledger — S1.11 (Land the reference-monitor security kernel & capability model, R-2.8.1 C0/Stage 1)

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/015_S1.11__reference-monitor.md` (cites
  `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5g.1 R-2.8.1 only — the C0/Stage-1 slice per the §5g tier
  map and ADR-0051/0052/0053 §(e): `AuthorityHandle` record + handle-table projection,
  root minting ∩ `authority_cap`, checks H-1/H-2/H-5, `authorize` steps 0–3 and 6, the
  Π interpreter + default table in both modes, the complete-mediation append rule,

  Inherited interim rules: ADR-0212 OQ-132 (closed `ResourcePattern` grammar open —
  the interim matcher is literal/prefix/`*`), OQ-133 (closed command grammar open —
  partial parse ⇒ `unknown` is ratified, the class list is not), OQ-201

- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.11`

- **Live stage:** offline-only — the monitor is a pure function over records; no
  runtime surface, no network, no clock/env reads. Verification is the `cargo` suites.

## Requirements
Satisfy + stamp: **R-2.8.1** (§5g.1 C0/Stage-1 per the tier map + ADR-0051/0052/0053
§(e)).

Landed surface (this ticket):
- New persistent crate `crates/hh-monitor` — the reference-monitor security kernel
  (TCB items (i)–(iv) and (viii) of §5g.1 §2.6). Deps only: hh-wire, hh-identity,
  hh-provenance, hh-ontology, hh-hir, hh-assembly, hh-compiler, hh-ledger (CC5/CC10).
  **No `Text` leaf, no model call on any path** — enforced by construction (no
  `Text` in any signature), by the static source check, and by the runtime guard.
- `handle.rs` — `HandleId` (allocated, opaque, `hnd-`-spelled), `OriginBasis`
  (`seal|approval|policy_rule|delegation|pin`), `HandleExpiry` (`effect|turn|run|
  session`), `HandleValidity`, `AuthorityHandle` (the §3 record verbatim) + the
  canonical JSON codec.
- `table.rs` — `HandleTable` projection: fold `security.permission.granted`/
  `revoked` envelopes; `project(events, until_seq)` rebuilds the table (rebuild
  equality is the testable invariant); `covering(...)` by holder/domain/scope;
  per-(handle,grant) decision counts for the `count` constraint; revocation cascade.
- `events.rs` — payload builders/decoders for `security.permission.granted`,
  `security.permission.revoked`, `security.permission.decided` (the
  `KernelDecision` row) over the one `hh_ledger::event::Event` shape (CC7).
- `mint.rs` — `mint_root_handles(sealed, principal, at, ids)`: every `Permission`
  entity of the sealed document; `issuer.authority ≥ principal` (I-H2 —
  `IllegitimateIssuer` below it); ceiling = `min(issuer.authority, every applicable
  `authority_cap` ceiling)` read from the sealed document's `assembly.constraints`
  (caps naming the permission's semantic id, plus `of = "*"`/absent-`of` global
  caps); `origin_basis = seal`; `issuer` = definition-authority provenance;
  `basis_ref` = `definition_ref`; returns `(handles, granted events)` minted before
  any untrusted read (H-3 — the function takes no content input at all).
- `args.rs` — the `SurfaceArgMap` evaluator (TCB viii): surface args → canonical
  params through `hh_compiler::equiv::SurfaceBinding`; unmapped argument ⇒
  `UnmappedArgument`; scope-bearing canonical params selected by
  `ScopeBindings`/`scope_kind`; a declared-but-missing kind ⇒ `UnscopedParameter`;
  `scope_bindings_unknown` ⇒ only `*` grants cover (ADR-0087 D3).
- `assess.rs` — `AssessmentInputs` (the recorded input record: canonical path,
  inside/outside writable roots, command class, host-in-allowlist, sole-recipient,
  compensation registered, attenuation, secret transport, destination∈grant.scope,
  spend-over-soft, pre-authorized) + the deterministic assessors (i) static
  `project_risk` and (ii) argument analysis (lexical path canonicalisation +
  writable-root containment, closed-grammar command classification — partial parse
  ⇒ `unknown`, host membership vs the declared allowlist). `Tri {yes,no,unknown}`
  is the honest three-valued input; `unknown` never satisfies a `yes`-condition.
- `policy.rs` — `PolicyTable{version_id, mode, rows[], default: deny,
  unattended_policy}` (MUST-data at `definition` authority), `PiCondition` (the
  closed condition sum), `PiVerdict {allow|ask|deny|raise}`, the interpreter
  (matching rows → most restrictive wins; `raise` post-pass; unattended override),
  `default_table(mode)` emitting Π-1…Π-12 + the domain-default rows + the
  ADR-0059 `secret_access` rows + the ADR-0031 untainted-`≥principal` floor, and
  `policy_delta` (the probe-enumerated narrowing diagnostic — widening ⇒
  `authority_delta = widening`, C2 owns the full classifier).
- `decision.rs` — `KernelDecision` (the §3 record minus the Stage-2
  `assessment_inputs_ref`/`cache_key`/`remedy_taken` — carried honestly absent),
  `DecisionKind {allow|ask{options,remedies}|deny{reason,remedies}}`, the closed
  `DenyReason` sum verbatim, `Decider {policy}` (only `policy` is produced at
  Stage 1; the sum is declared complete), `CheckRecord[]` (the reconstructible
  check trail).
- `monitor.rs` — `Monitor{table, policy, capabilities, proposers, open_model_call,
  config}`; `authorize(p, at)` runs steps 0 (well-formedness), 1 (effective
  authority via `hh_provenance::effective_authority`), 2 (grant coverage + handle
  validity + count/time), 3 (`max_by_danger(kernel_assessed, projected(declared),
  self_report)` — self-report raise-only), 4's *authority-form* half (Π gate: `eff
  ≤ external ∨ taint ≠ ∅` consults Π; untainted `≥ principal` runs the ADR-0031
  floor), and 6 (delegation attenuation for `spawn_process`). `delegate(...)`,
  `revoke(...)`, `resolve_handles(...)`.
- `leak.rs` — `HandleLeak` checks: static over a compiled surface record /
  `model_surface` JSON; runtime over outgoing context items (any `hnd-` spelling or
  live handle id embedded in a string leaf).
- `context.rs` — `stamp_context_label(delivered)` — the kernel-owned wrapper over
  `hh_provenance::context_label` (I-H9: the variant supplies the delivered-item
  list, never the label).
- `guard.rs` — `DecisionGuard`/`ModelCallGuard` (runtime assertion: a model call
  while a decision is open trips `ModelCallDuringDecision`; `authorize` holds the
  guard for its duration).
- `tcb.rs` — the TCB enumeration (the §2.6 inside/outside list as data) + the
  static dependency check over the authorize-path source files.
- `hh-ledger` — the complete-mediation append rule (ADR-0052 D6, I-H7): the run
  state folds `security.permission.decided` into a `(effect_id, attempt) →
  gate-decision` table (`decision ∈ {allow, deny}` are the final gate verdicts —
  exactly one per attempt cycle; `ask`/request-closure rows are non-final);
  `action.effect.committed{attempt_no}` is refused `LedgerError::Undecided` unless
  `allow` is recorded for that attempt.
- `hh-compiler` — E2 strengthened to arg-map *totality*: a `ToolSurface.
  argument_order` member absent from the binding's `arg_map` fails E2 (AC-10's
  static half; previously totality was by-construction only).

## Acceptance criteria (gating — §9.1; deterministic halves executable)
- **AC-R-2.8.1-2 (AT-H1-02, Stage-1 static half):** forged authority text, a
  valid-looking `HandleId` and a forged `decided` payload planted in a tool-result
  `Observation` and a workspace file ⇒ decisions byte-identical to the clean run
  (the monitor's inputs never include them); `HandleLeak` passes on clean content
  and errors on a live-handle spelling; no monitor input derives from `Text`
  (type-level + static source check).
- **AC-R-2.8.1-10 (AT-H1-10, Stage-1 static):** a surface field absent from
  `SurfaceArgMap` fails compilation (E2 totality, this run); at runtime an
  argument outside the mapped domain ⇒ `UnmappedArgument`; renaming the surface
  changes no decision.
- **AC-R-2.8.1-11 (AT-H1-11, Stage-1 static + runtime):** the static dependency
  check proves the authorize path references no model-call operation and no
  `Text` reader (and fails when one is introduced); the runtime assertion trips on
  a model call while a decision is open.
- AC-R-2.8.1-{1,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,12,13,14,15,16} are Stage-2/3/4 (per the §9.1
  stage assignments + ADR §(e) rows) — deferral row.

   closeout.

## Progress
- Branch created `svitali/harnessharness-s1.11` @ `5100ee7`; `cargo check
  --workspace` baseline green.
- `hh-ledger`: the complete-mediation append rule landed —
  `effect::DecisionFolds` keyed on `(effect_id, attempt_no)`, final verdicts
  (`allow`/`deny`) only; `validate_decision` in the append loop enforces
  exactly-one-final-decided per attempt cycle (`DuplicateDecision`) and
  `committed` gates on a prior `decided{allow}` (`Undecided`);
  `apply_decision` is the lenient rebuild fold (ADR-0242 §2). All four
  `committed`-emitting test call sites + `hh-budget`'s account test updated to
  append the decision first.
- `crates/hh-monitor` landed (13 modules; see Landed surface above).
- `hh-compiler` E2 strengthened: `e2_check` now proves `arg_map` totality over
  the surface's `argument_order` — an absent field fails compilation
  (ADR-0242 §9; AC-R-2.8.1-10 static half).
- Self-review: Π row-evaluation reworked so domain rows specialize the floor
  (domain-specific cells for `model_call`/`secret_access`/`spawn_process`
  landed; Π-3 complement and Π-5 otherwise cases fixed); the TCB token scan
  blanks string literals and matches on token boundaries (`try_model_call(`
  and `"model_call("` literals no longer false-positive); delegate's request
  packs as `ChildSpec` (clippy `too_many_arguments`); `Tri::default` derived.
- `cargo test --workspace` all-green; `cargo fmt --check` clean; `cargo clippy
  --workspace --all-targets --all-features -D warnings` clean.
